extracted.name: Peanut Butter Breakfast Syrup
extracted.description: Make a pancake syrup quickly with just four ingredients: milk, peanut butter, sugar, and vanilla extract.
instruction_lines: Stir milk, sugar, and peanut butter together in a saucepan over medium heat; bring to a boil while whisking constantly. Cook at a boil for 3 minutes, remove from heat, and stir vanilla extract into the syrup.
